title: test(i18n): pin that the two defaults-population walks agree (#7904)
body:
Fixes #7904

One new test, `scripts/__tests__/defaults-population-parity-7904.test.ts`. Neither walk moves; nothing else in the tree changes.

## What it pins

Two independently written AST walks discover the same `createSafeTranslation` defaults-table population — `scanDefaultsTables` in `packages/test-support/src/defaults-table-scan.ts` (objectui#7884, read by the two vitest gates) and the script's own `scanFactorySites` / `resolveFactoryTable` behind `analyze()` in `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` (objectui#7567). They agree exactly today and nothing asserted it, so the day one of them learns a new table shape and the other does not, one gate goes on reporting full coverage of a population the other has already grown past.

This is the pin, not a merge. `scripts/*.mjs` run under bare node and cannot import the TypeScript-source module the vitest gates share, and giving the scripts lane a loader or a build step is a capability expansion with no pull beyond this one gate. Shape follows `scripts/__tests__/placeholder-spelling-parity.test.ts` (objectui#7310): floors first, then equality, plus the "is asking two different implementations" guard so a future merge of the walks must delete this file rather than leave it reading as a guarantee.

The numbers are read through the script's exported `analyze(root).counters`, not off its prose census line — no spawn, no regex.

## The mapping — comparing like with like

The trap the card names: `scanDefaultsTables` walks the factory call sites AND THEN appends every declared hand-rolled table into ONE `rows` / `tables` pair, while the script keeps `factory*` and `handRolled*` counters deliberately separate. Comparing the scan's totals against the script's factory counters would compare 1072 rows against 841 and be red for a reason that is not drift. So the scan side is partitioned first:

- **Hand-rolled half** — the scan labels a registry table exactly `NAME (file)`, derived from the same `HAND_ROLLED_TABLES` both sides read (objectui#7877 put the data in one JSON file, so this is one declaration, not two copies). A factory label always carries a line number, `NAME (file:LINE)`, so the two label shapes cannot collide.
- **Factory half** — every other label, and the rows carrying it.
- **The overlap** — `TIMELINE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` is in the registry AND reaches the factory. The script de-duplicates on the literal's own position and counts it as `handRolledAlreadyFactoryCovered`; the scan double-lists it on purpose and tells callers to de-duplicate on `where` plus `key`. This test is that caller.

Counter by counter, as asserted:

| scan side (`defaults-table-scan.ts`) | script side (`analyze().counters`) | today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| factory table labels | `factorySites` | 32 |
| distinct factory literals | `factoryTables` | 32 |
| factory rows | `factoryRows` | 841 |
| `HAND_ROLLED_TABLES.length` | `handRolledDeclared` | 3 |
| hand-rolled labels, overlap-free | `handRolledTables` | 2 |
| hand-rolled labels in the overlap | `handRolledAlreadyFactoryCovered` | 1 |
| hand-rolled rows, overlap-free | `handRolledRows` | 215 |
| `scan.unreadable` is empty | all four unreadable counters at 0 | 0 |

Two of those rows hold only because of a property of today's tree, and the file asserts both before the equalities rather than assuming them: `factorySites` counts invocations including ones whose table never resolves (equal to the label count only while `factoryUnreadableTables` is 0), and `factoryTables` counts distinct literals while the scan pushes one label per site (distinct literals are recovered from each table's row signature, which needs every factory table to contribute at least one row — asserted, since two empty tables would share the empty signature). The header records both, and records the two known definitional differences this tree does not exercise: the scan descends into nested object literals where the script deliberately counts one as an unreadable row, and the scan accepts a property-access callee where the script requires a bare identifier.

Floors before equality, so the pin cannot pass over two empty walks: 1591 source files walked, more than 25 factory sites, more than 700 factory rows on both sides, more than 150 overlap-free hand-rolled rows on both sides (the same 150 the script's own collapse floor uses), and zero unreadable entries on both sides.

## Today's readings, both sides

`node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` at `ed4a1f810`, its census lines quoted as the control that the numbers asserted are the numbers it prints:

```
Factory defaults tables: 32 createSafeTranslation site(s) over 32 distinct table(s) (0 unreadable) — 841 row(s) compared against their en value, 841 matching, 0 on a key en does not define, 0 with no single comparable en value, 0 unreadable.
Hand-rolled defaults tables: 3 declared, 2 scanned here (1 already covered by the factory walk, 0 unreadable) — 215 row(s) compared against their en value, 215 matching, 0 on a key en does not define, 0 with no single comparable en value, 0 unreadable.
```

Scan side, measured in the same process as the assertions: 35 table labels total, of which 32 factory (32 distinct literals) and 3 hand-rolled; 1072 rows, of which 841 factory and 231 hand-rolled, 215 of them once the 16 rows of the overlapping `TIMELINE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` literal are attributed to the factory half where the script already counts them; `unreadable` empty; 1591 runtime source files walked. The card's numbers (32 / 841 / 0) were re-measured on this base rather than inherited, and the hand-rolled half was measured for the first time here.

Cost: `scanDefaultsTables` about 0.5s, `analyze` about 3s, both in the collection phase so neither sits inside a test's timeout budget. The whole file runs in 4.4s.

## Positive control — proof the pin can go red

Narrowed the SCRIPT's recogniser in the working tree so its factory walk stops seeing the one `createSafeTranslationHook` call site (`packages/plugin-detail/src/useDetailTranslation.ts`), leaving the shared scan's recogniser intact. Probe only — neither walk is in this PR's file surface.

Anchor observed before and after the edit (canonical spelling 1 then 0, narrowed spelling 0 then 1), mutated blob hash `2d34345c` different from the HEAD blob `dea6c08d`, so the mutation demonstrably reached disk. The pin went red, exit 1, three of four cases failing and the equality case naming the counters:

```
factorySites: defaults-table-scan.ts -> 32, check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs -> 31
factoryTables: defaults-table-scan.ts -> 32, check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs -> 31
factoryRows: defaults-table-scan.ts -> 841, check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs -> 666
```

The recogniser guard failed alongside it (`createSafeTranslation, createSafeTranslationHook` against `createSafeTranslation`), and so did the row floor (666 is not greater than 700) — three independent alarms for one narrowing.

Restore proven, not assumed: `git checkout HEAD -- scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` under a `trap` with absolute paths, then the restored blob hash read back as `dea6c08d`, byte-equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates, all at `ed4a1f810`

Exit codes captured by redirect-then-capture, never through a pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/defaults-population-parity-7904.test.ts` — exit 0, 4 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/placeholder-spelling-parity.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-i18n-call-site-keys.test.ts` — exit 0, 141 passed. Neither file changes.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` — exit 0, 114 files, 3376 tests passed.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` — exit 0, census quoted above.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` — exit 0. Both package-owned imports are relative, as `scripts/__tests__/scripts-type-check.test.ts` pins.
- `pnpm lint:root` — exit 0 (32 pre-existing warnings, none in the new file).
- `pnpm check:control-bytes` — exit 0, 6505 tracked text files scanned; plus a targeted `grep -naP` self-scan of the new file, no hits.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — exit 0, none owed (1 file changed, 0 published source).
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/__tests__/defaults-population-parity-7904.test.ts` — exit 0, NOT GOVERNED.
- `pnpm check:entry-guard` — exit 0.
